csv_agency: Eastern Rio Blanco Metropolitan Recreation Dist
csv_scope_of_work: The Eastern Rio Blanco Metropolitan Recreation & Park District (ERBM) is seeking proposals from qualified consulting firms to provide professional services for the revision of the District's 2012 Recreation, Trails and Parks Master Plan. The successful firm will provide a comprehensive roadmap to guide the ERBM Board of Directors and leadership staff in making critical programming, operational, and capital investment decisions. The primary focus of this update is to align District services with current community demands, specifically targeting increased recreational programming, expanded outdoor recreation assets, and facility expansion of the Meeker Recreation Center. This project is partially funded by a Great Outdoors Colorado (GOCO) Community Impact Grant.
